correctness.rationale: For smooth C_eta outside F_s, N1=1 by F_s-norm/F_s-trace obstruction. Translation parameter c satisfies c^q-c=delta=eta-eta^s, with delta^s=-delta and delta!=0, so twist order p; its nonzero powers are conjugate by F_q unitary scaling. Hermitian H has q+1+2gs rational points, hence all H^1 Frobenius eigenvalues -s. N1 gives Tr(U^j)=-s for 1<=j<p. Character orthogonality yields invariant multiplicity s^2/p-s and each nontrivial root multiplicity s^2/p; determinant and all power traces give stated P(T), N_{q^n}. Checked s=2,3 small finite predictions and packaged code; full unrestricted claim uses algebraic proof, not finite examples.
